coordinateSystem: Original Washington Square origin; Y up; map units in meters.
exportedModels: Generated landmark, scenery and tile GLBs already preserve site coordinates. Load at identity.

washingtonSquareArch.normalization: Center model in X/Z and align minimum Y to zero. Scale uniformly to data.height. Place at centroid of footprint excluding repeated last point, Y=0.68. Rotate Y=-atan2(first edge Z, first edge X). Set material color #f1ede4, roughness 0.86, double sided.
